items.title: Chrome High-Severity Vulnerability Let Attackers Execute Arbitrary Code
items.description: Google has released an emergency security update for Chrome to address a critical vulnerability that could allow attackers to crash the browser or execute arbitrary code on affected systems. The high-severity flaw, designated as CVE-2025-9132, affects Chrome’s V8 JavaScript engine and was discovered by Google’s automated vulnerability detection system, Big Sleep, on August 4, 2025. items.title: DOJ Charges 22-Year-Old for Running RapperBot Botnet Behind 370,000 DDoS Attacks
items.description: A 22-year-old man from the U.S. state of Oregon has been charged with allegedly developing and overseeing a distributed denial-of-service (DDoS)-for-hire botnet called RapperBot. items.title: Asian Orgs Shift Cybersecurity Requirements to Suppliers
items.description: The uptick in breaches in Asia has prompted a Japanese chipmaker and the Singaporean government to require vendors to pass cybersecurity checks to do business.
